answer: Each identity posts bonded collateral in a vault, so splitting stake does not erase accountability: when k coordinated keys equivocate on the same consensus duty, correlated penalties aggregate as Θ(k²), not as k isolated fines. Detection may also apply an exponential capital-loss multiplier across the linked swarm, making larger sybil operations increasingly costly; asymmetric depreciation drives exposed bonds toward nadir, while honest participation preserves the nectar of predictable rewards.
